title: Brewfather Coffee Recipe TDS Leaderboard
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brewfather:coffee tds_pct=*
| stats sum(tds_pct) as total_value, avg(tds_pct) as avg_value by recipe_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks recipe name values by total and average tds across Brewfather coffee recipe events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `tds_pct` values for each Brewfather coffee recipe event and review total and average tds by recipe name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total tds.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which recipe name shows the biggest tds numbers in your Brewfather coffee recipe data.
